body:
## Origin and authorized scope

The maintainer authorized: "You have my approval to do the cleanup, and you have my approval to generate the H700 build. Following the H700 build, we should try the SM8550 build."

Latest status request: "is work still in progress?"

#492's SM8550 firmware build stopped at723/737 on2026-10-07 12:03:57UTC in fex-emu:target. The watcher/acceptance owners recorded failure and independently verified their process exits. No compiler was active at15:00UTC. Investigation resumes here; recording the failure during the copy review had not repaired or restarted it.

## Proved cause and accepted controls

FEX e869aa644a16e4332cdc15c1ea0b4d13d482385d guest-libs-32 fails compiling the Wayland/GL guest libraries. GCC16.2.0 limits under Nix Clang21.1.8 reports a builtin bit-cast from12-byte long double to16-byte float128. The failing i686 command includes the handheld's aarch64 sysroot/usr/include with -I ahead of the Nix guest sysroot. That ARM64 bits/floatn.h aliases builtin_nansf128 to builtin_nansl. GuestLibs/CMakeLists.txt uses pkg-config include paths inherited from the device build. Header contamination is now proved: both original failing source commands fail with the ARM64 standard include and pass when only that include is removed. Fresh actual CMake/Ninja controls reproduce the original32 failure and compile/link six fixed32 and nine fixed64 guest libraries. Exact original Nix2.35.2/nixpkgs snapshot, Clang21.1.8 and rootfs identities were restored; no downgrade or architecture removal. Both control owners have four zero channels, five intact seals and independently verified process exits. The two-line CMake helper fix and compact evidence are published on next6b627a38ae3182bf73310ff8819ae4f17da79e36 (featureb3aef8a38f). Full target package/firmware acceptance remains open.

Build tree: /workspace/repos/rocknix.worktrees/m7-pixelelated-sm8550-01 at40f80c5151d5c9281be5ca95121e0a1fe0d918d9. Original log: build.pixelelated-SM8550.aarch64/.threads/logs/724.log. Original owners: /workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-sm8550-build-01 and /workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-sm8550-acceptance-01. Preserve their seals and failure results. The ephemeral build container removed its Nix store on exit; reconstruct exact compiler inputs or explicitly record any difference used by a probe. Do not claim an exact reproduction from a different compiler.

Already written: no SM8550 image has been accepted from this run. H700 artifacts and installed RG35XX SP remain accepted. No device/cloud changes are part of this repair.

Can this be done on the VM? The common product behavior is already qualified there. This failure is a cross-compilation host fact; isolate it in the pinned build container with captured compiler/header commands, then prove the repaired SM8550 package and firmware. No handheld is needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Preserve the original failure/thread logs and enumerate interrupted packages before any cleanup or retry; compact evidence identifies the frozen input and failed owners.
- [x] A compiler/header control reproduces the failure and distinguishes ARM64-header contamination from an intrinsic i686 compiler/library incompatibility, recording exact versions and include provenance.
- [x] A scoped fix passes its unfixed/fixed controls and package/patch checks, preserves all FEX features, and yields both32-bit and64-bit guest libraries plus the target package.
- [x] Resume under fresh watched build/acceptance owners; terminal results and actual artifacts pass #492's SM8550 verification. Preserve source custody and any still-open physical/publication gates.

No downgrade, disabled32-bit functionality, broad cache deletion, or change to the accepted H700 source is inferred.

## Firmware acceptance — 2026-10-07 16:52 UTC

SM8550 firmware artifacts are ACCEPTED from frozen0553c0193ace3aebbefaae5b7b6d49253c2811d9. All737 packages completed; build04 returned0 at16:51:14UTC and its fourzero channels/13seals/exits were verified16:51:39. Independent firmware acceptance passed16:52:00; fourzero channels/3seals/exits and controllerPASS were consumed16:52:09. Raw/update equality, GPT/ABL, lowercase identity,187ARM handoff files,14FEX files, and installed qualified English/French migration copy passed. Independent bundle97367c3235fab7cc6d1ec2b54c390fe7ceff786612f29c9f177aaa288a33fb18 is retained; scratch was removed. Original01 product and02/03 helper failures remain preserved. Source/licence inventory, per-image qualification mapping, named physical smoke and publication remain separate; no Nova deployment or RC designation. Evidence: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-device-builds/sm8550-resume04/.
